translation: A blessing in disguise.
Step by step leaves a footprint.
Constant dripping wears away the stone.

pinyin: shǒu dé yún kāi jiàn yuè míng
translation: Hold on; the clouds will part and the moon will shine.

pinyin: huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
translation: Live until you are old; learn until you are old.
The hardest part of anything is the beginning.
Contentment brings lasting joy.
Heaven rewards the diligent.
You reap what you sow.
The sea accepts a hundred rivers.
Little by little becomes much.
May the wind be at your sails.
May your wishes come true.
Learning has no end.
Think thrice before you act.
You become like those you spend time with.
A word from the noble is enough.
Better late than never to mend the fence.

pinyin: bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
translation: Seeing once beats hearing a hundred times.
Fallen leaves return to the roots.

pinyin: qiān lǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zú xià
translation: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
When drinking water, remember its source.
Learn, and practice often what you have learned.
Time flies like an arrow.
May laughter always be on your lips.
Know yourself and know your opponent.
Something arises from nothing.
Be at peace with whatever comes.
Let nature take its course.
Stand firmly on the ground.
Great wisdom often looks like simplicity.
Burn the boats; commit fully.
Press forward bravely.
The four seas are your home.
Your future is boundless.
Good medicine often tastes bitter.
Not advancing is retreating.
Walk with the wind at your feet.
Sincerity can open stone and metal.
Keep your lips sealed like a bottle.
When you sing, you will astound.
Good things take effort to polish.
Add flowers to the brocade.
The sky is wide; let the bird fly.
Fate decides who you meet.
Deep virtue can carry all things.
Have a finished plan in your heart.
Look at life with a smile.
A calm heart cools naturally.
May dreams come true.
